description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Shield Sphere.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
